starters_on_report.name: Jon Gaines II
starters_on_report.note: Gaines (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
starters_on_report.detail: Gaines will miss a fourth consecutive game while recovering from an ankle injury, and his next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Commanders on Sunday, Nov. 29. Hjalte Froholdt has cleared the league's concussion protocol and is slated to start at center against Kansas City.

starters_on_report.name: Hjalte Froholdt
starters_on_report.note: Froholdt (concussion) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
starters_on_report.detail: Froholdt was a full practice participant both Thursday and Friday, and he's progressed enough in his recovery to clear the league's concussion protocol. With Jon Gaines (ankle) ruled out, Froholdt should reclaim his starting job at center for Sunday's road tilt.

starters_on_report.name: Josh Johnson
starters_on_report.note: Johnson is expected to start Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.
starters_on_report.detail: With Carson Beck (back) not expected to practice Friday or play Sunday, Johnson appears in line to step into the starting quarterback role for Arizona. Johnson has a career 14:18 TD:INT across 50 regular-season appearances. The entire Arizona offense is one to avoid when making fantasy lineup decisions for Week 11.

starters_on_report.name: Carson Beck
starters_on_report.note: Beck (back) will not practice Friday, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.
starters_on_report.detail: After being listed as limited Thursday, Beck's looming absence from Friday's practice -- the result of back spasms flaring up -- per Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site, clouds his status for Sunday's game at Kansas City. For now, coach Mike LaFleur said the team will proceed as if Josh Johnson will make the start at quarterback, though the door hasn't been completely closed on the…

starters_on_report.name: Walter Nolen III
starters_on_report.note: Nolen (illness) was a full participant in practice Thursday, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
starters_on_report.detail: The defensive tackle was not able to practice Wednesday due to an illness. Now that he's back, he should be able to play Sunday against the Chiefs. Nolen has played on a majority of the defensive snaps in each game he's been available for this season, recording 25 tackles (eight solo), including 1.0 sacks.

starters_on_report.name: Budda Baker
starters_on_report.note: Baker posted six tackles (two solo) during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams in Week 10.
starters_on_report.detail: It was the third consecutive week that Baker recorded at least six stops (and the sixth time this season). The veteran safety is up to 68 tackles (31 solo), including a career-high 3.5 sacks, four pass defenses (including one interception) and one forced fumble through 10 regular-season games. Baker was held out of Wednesday's practice for rest purposes, so he should be available for Sunday's…

starters_on_report.name: Mack Wilson Sr.
starters_on_report.note: Wilson registered 10 tackles (six solo) during the Cardinals' 34-6 loss to the Rams in Week 10.
starters_on_report.detail: The Cardinals were blown out at home in Week 10, but Wilson came away from the loss with a season-high 10 stops while playing every single defensive snap. The veteran linebacker is up to 72 total tackles through 10 regular-season games, and he is three stops shy from matching his career-high that he set in 2024 with the Cardinals (over 16 regular-season contests).

starters_on_report.name: Gardner Minshew II
starters_on_report.note: Minshew (elbow) underwent UCL reconstructive surgery Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
starters_on_report.detail: Though the procedure will bring an end to Minshew's season, he's expected to make a full recovery ahead of the 2027 campaign. The veteran quarterback sustained the injury while making his lone start of the season Week 9 in Seattle, but he played though the elbow issue and completed 21 of 30 passes for 166 yards. Rookie third-round pick Carson Beck took over as the Cardinals' starting quarterback…

starters_on_report.name: Andrew Wingard
starters_on_report.note: Wingard (wrist) was placed on injured reserve by the Cardinals on Tuesday.
starters_on_report.detail: Wingard picked up a wrist injury in the team's 34-6 loss to the Rams in Week 10, and he will now be forced to miss at least four contests while recovering from the injury. In Wingard's absence, Kitan Crawford and Dadrion Taylor-Demerson are both candidates to replace him as the team's starting free safety Sunday versus the Chiefs.

starters_on_report.name: Jaylinn Hawkins
starters_on_report.note: Ravens coach Jesse Minter announced Friday that Hawkins (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Panthers.
starters_on_report.detail: Hawkins was a limited participant throughout the practice week, but it isn't enough for him to return in Week 11. The 29-year-old will miss his fifth straight game due to a knee injury. K'Von Wallace will continue to take reps in Hawkins' place.

starters_on_report.name: Nnamdi Madubuike
starters_on_report.note: Ravens coach Jesse Minter announced Friday that Madubuike (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Panthers.
starters_on_report.detail: Madubuike popped up on the injury report as a non-participant in back-to-back practices due to a hamstring injury. With the 29-year-old out, John Jenkins will likely see a higher snap count on defense. Madubuike has 22 tackles (12 solo), including 1.0 sacks, and two pass deflections in eight regular-season games.

starters_on_report.name: Olaivavega Ioane
starters_on_report.note: Ioane (shoulder/knee) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.
starters_on_report.detail: The offensive guard was limited during Wednesday's session. Ioane left Monday's loss to the Chargers with a shoulder injury and didn't return. The first-round pick out of Penn State has started all nine games he's played in this season.

starters_on_report.note: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Humphrey won't play Sunday against the Panthers after the defensive back made a derogatory comment about the city of Baltimore in an episode of his podcast released Wednesday,…
starters_on_report.detail: Minter noted that after holding "internal conversations," he and the Ravens' brain trust decided to deactivate Humphrey for Week 11. Per Hensley, Humphrey acknowledged after Wednesday's practice that he regretted the comments he made in the podcast and issued an apology, so he's not expected to face any discipline beyond being held out of the matchup with the Panthers. Through the Ravens' first…

starters_on_report.name: Lamar Jackson
starters_on_report.note: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.
starters_on_report.detail: Last Friday, head coach Jesse Minter announced that Jackson was facing a projected recovery timeline of 6-to-10 weeks after requiring a procedure to address a broken and dislocated thumb. A Week 16 return would be right up against the short end of that timeline, so if Jackson has shown notable improvement by that point, he could push to play if the 4-6 Ravens haven't faded from the playoff…

starters_on_report.name: Roquan Smith
starters_on_report.note: Smith finished Monday's Week 10 loss to the Chargers with eight tackles (six solo).
starters_on_report.detail: Kyle Hamilton led Baltimore with 10 tackles, and Smith was among three players who finished second with eight stops apiece. The veteran linebacker has hit the eight-tackle mark in four straight games and in eight of his 10 contests overall this season. Smith is tied for 11th in the NFL with 82 tackles on the campaign.

starters_on_report.name: Kyle Hamilton
starters_on_report.note: Hamilton posted 10 tackles (three solo) against the Chargers in Monday's Week 10 loss.
starters_on_report.detail: Hamilton is managing a hip injury but played all but one of Baltimore's defensive snaps Monday. He led the team with 10 stops, which were the second-most he's recorded in a contest so far this season. Hamilton seems to be on his way to a third consecutive triple-digit tackle campaign, as he has 70 stops through 10 games on the season.

starters_on_report.name: Rashod Bateman
starters_on_report.note: Bateman brought in three of five targets for 42 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
starters_on_report.detail: Bateman put together a solid performance during his first opportunity to work with Jacoby Brissett, posting his best receiving yardage total since Week 5. The veteran wideout also recorded multiple receptions for the first time in three games, and two of his three catches went for first downs. Bateman seemed to lay a solid foundation with his new signal-caller, and he'll look to continue…

starters_on_report.name: Mark Andrews
starters_on_report.note: Andrews brought in all eight targets for 82 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday.
starters_on_report.detail: According to Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site, Andrews confirmed after Monday's game that he's been playing through a broken left hand since Week 3, but he finally appears to be back to full health. Though he didn't miss any time due to broken hand, he was listed on the injury report from Weeks 4 through 9 before avoiding the report entirely for Week 10. He proceeded to deliver a…

starters_on_report.name: Zay Flowers
starters_on_report.note: Flowers brought in six of seven targets for 74 yards and lost a fumble in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
starters_on_report.detail: After being held to just three catches for six yards over the previous two games while Joe Fagnano primarily led the Ravens offense, Flowers got a major reprieve in the form of the debuting Jacoby Brissett. The talented wideout took advantage by finishing second in receptions and receiving yards for Baltimore on the night, but Flowers had the ball stripped from him after a 15-yard catch at the…

starters_on_report.name: Jacoby Brissett
starters_on_report.note: Brissett completed 33 of 49 passes for 340 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for two yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.
starters_on_report.detail: Brissett looked like a natural fit in coordinator Declan Doyle's offense despite having only practiced a handful of days with the Ravens following his trade from the Cardinals, amassing his highest passing yardage total since Week 11 of last season. As he'd often done with Trey McBride in Arizona, Brissett focused heavily on the tight-end position in his Baltimore debut, connecting with Mark…

starters_on_report.name: Kedon Slovis
starters_on_report.note: Slovis (coach's decision) is inactive but serving as the Ravens' emergency No. 3 quarterback Monday night versus the Chargers.
starters_on_report.detail: Slovis will operate as Baltimore's third option at QB for the second straight week. He will only be eligible to enter the game if both starter Jacoby Brissett and backup Joe Fagnano are removed from the contest.

starters_on_report.name: Nate Wiggins
starters_on_report.note: Wiggins (illness) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.
starters_on_report.detail: Wiggins was inactive for the Week 9 meeting with the Jaguars. However, after logging a full practice session Thursday, it appears he is good to go for Week 10 against the Chargers. The 23-year-old has appeared in eight games this season, garnering 24 total tackles (17 solo) and four passes defensed.

starters_on_report.name: Bobby Okereke
starters_on_report.note: Okereke (foot) is out for Sunday's matchup against the Ravens, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
starters_on_report.detail: Okereke hasn't practiced all week and will miss his third straight game due to a foot injury likely suffered in Week 8. Tyrel Dodson is slated to get another start.

starters_on_report.name: Will Lee III
starters_on_report.note: Lee (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
starters_on_report.detail: Lee missed the Panthers' last two games due to a hamstring injury. However, his full participation in Wednesday's practice indicates that the rookie fourth-rounder has fully recovered from his injury, and Lee should be back on the field for the Panthers against the Ravens on Sunday.

starters_on_report.name: Bryce Young
starters_on_report.note: Young was listed with a sore foot on Wednesday's injury report but was a full participant in the Panthers' first Week 11 practice.
starters_on_report.detail: Per Steve Reed of the Associated Press, head coach Dave Canales said that Young experienced some soreness in his foot coming out of Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. However, after receiving treatment over the last couple of days, Young responded well enough to take every rep in practice to kick off Week 11 prep. The signal-caller isn't expected to face any limitations during this Sunday's…

starters_on_report.name: Tyrel Dodson
starters_on_report.note: Dodson logged seven tackles (two solo) Sunday in a 20-17 win over New Orleans.
starters_on_report.detail: Dodson finished second on the Panthers in stops behind Devin Lloyd (nine). It was the second straight start for Dodson as a result of Bobby Okereke being sidelined by a foot injury. If Okereke can't return for this Sunday's matchup against Baltimore, Dodson would figure to start and handle an every-down role again.

starters_on_report.name: Devin Lloyd
starters_on_report.note: Lloyd registered nine tackles (five solo) and an interception in Sunday's 20-17 win over New Orleans.
starters_on_report.detail: Lloyd was prolific as a tackler, leading Carolina with nine stops. He also put an end to the Saints' first offensive possession of the game with an interception of Tyler Shough. The pickoff was Lloyd's third of the campaign, a tally he's now reached in three of his five NFL seasons. With 63 tackles through eight contests, Lloyd is also on pace to reach triple-digit tackles for the fourth time.

starters_on_report.name: Marco Wilson
starters_on_report.note: The Panthers signed Wilson from the practice squad to the active roster Monday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
starters_on_report.detail: Wilson has started the last three games at cornerback as a practice-squad elevation, and the Panthers have now made room for him on the 53-man roster. Wilson is set to start Sunday's game against the Ravens at outside cornerback opposite Will Lee (hamstring) or Corey Thornton. The Panthers released linebacker Nick Hampton in a corresponding move.

starters_on_report.name: Jalen Coker
starters_on_report.note: Coker failed to catch any of his four targets in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
starters_on_report.detail: While it looked like Coker was going to be in line for a breakout 2026 season after his 8-138-2 receiving performance in the Week 1 opener, Coker has been held to 23 catches for 255 yards and one touchdown over his last seven games. At this point, he can't be trusted in fantasy lineups until he shows something in the box score again. This was a pristine on-paper spot versus New Orleans in the…

starters_on_report.name: Tetairoa McMillan
starters_on_report.note: McMillan caught three of seven targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over New Orleans.
starters_on_report.detail: The seven targets led the Panthers on the afternoon, but the second-year wideout wasn't able to do much with them. The 35 yards were McMillan's lowest total since Week 3, and he'll take a 49-660-3 line on 78 targets through nine games into a Week 11 tilt against the Ravens.

starters_on_report.name: Chuba Hubbard
starters_on_report.note: Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 92 yards and two touchdowns and caught all five of his targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.
starters_on_report.detail: The 27-year-old RB kept the Panthers' offense afloat nearly single-handedly, as he set a new career high with 172 scrimmage yards while scoring both the team's TDs, on a two-yard run in the first quarter and a one-yard plunge in the fourth. Hubbard's 80 receiving yards were easily a new career high, topping the 3-57-0 line on three targets he recorded in Week 15 of the 2022 season against the…

starters_on_report.name: Jaelan Phillips
starters_on_report.note: Phillips (hamstring) is active against the Saints on Sunday, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
starters_on_report.detail: Phillips has been cleared by medical staff to return from a three-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Prior to the injury, he accumulated 10 tackles (three solo), including 2.5 sacks, across five regular-season games. His return will bolster the Panthers' pass rush alongside Patrick Jones, Trevis Gipson and Princely Umanmielen.

starters_on_report.detail: Keenum will once again operate as the team's emergency QB option in Week 9, making it four games in a row in that role. The 38-year-old will only be eligible to enter the game if both starter Caleb Williams and backup Tyson Bagent are forced out of the contest.

starters_on_report.name: Grady Jarrett
starters_on_report.note: Jarrett (groin) does not carry an official injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus the Buccaneers.
starters_on_report.detail: After missing the Bears' walk-through practice Wednesday, Jarrett logged a limited practice Thursday and then upgraded again to a full practice Friday. He should start on the interior of the defensive line next to Jeffery Simmons again in Week 9.
